messages.subject: -INf in table
parts:
Hi,
I'm using R studio + shiny on Ubuntu 14.... I'm trying to display a datatable which works fine as long as the table does not contain -INF. I have not tested INF but I assume the problem would be the same. I get the following warning in R and a javascript popup on the screen (see attachment). It seems to work sometimes but I can not figure out under what circumstances it works or when it fails.

Error in setMethod("toJSON", "numeric", function(x, container = isContainer(x,  :
  no existing definition for function ‘toJSON’

Has anyone encountered this and is there any way to fix this?

Regards

Christoph

messages.author: 167ba54486295fa6
messages.subject: Re: -INf in table
parts:
Update: It seems to work fine if there is at least one column of class character in the table. In case they are all numeric I get the Error. Even though I found a work around I would still be interested in a solution.

Thanks

Christoph
